detailed_description: The Text to Speech tool uses the browser speech synthesis API to read typed text aloud. Enter text, choose one of the voices exposed by your browser, then adjust rate and pitch before clicking Speak. The available voices and languages depend on the operating system and browser. The tool can stop active playback, but it does not export MP3 files, edit SSML, or generate server-side audio.
usage_steps: Enter or paste text into the text area.
Choose an available browser voice from the voice dropdown.
Adjust the rate slider if you want faster or slower speech.
Adjust the pitch slider if you want a higher or lower voice.
Click Stop to cancel the current speech.
usage_examples: Listen to a short note before using it in a presentation.
Compare how different installed browser voices pronounce the same phrase.
Slow down speech while practicing pronunciation or listening comprehension.
Preview accessibility-friendly wording by hearing the text aloud.
